abilities.name: Blaze
abilities.effect: Strengthens Fire moves to inflict 1.5× damage at 1/3 max HP or less.
abilities.flavor_text: Powers up Fire-type moves when the Pokémon's HP is low.

abilities.name: Libero
abilities.effect: Libero changes the Pokémon's type to that of its previously used attack.
abilities.flavor_text: Changes the Pokémon's type to the type of the move it's about to use. This works only once each time the Pokémon enters battle.

abilities.name: Synchronize
abilities.effect: Copies burns, paralysis, and poison received onto the Pokémon that inflicted them.
abilities.flavor_text: If the Pokémon is burned, paralyzed, or poisoned by another Pokémon, that Pokémon will be inflicted with the same status condition.

abilities.name: Telepathy
abilities.effect: Protects against friendly Pokémon's damaging moves.
abilities.flavor_text: The Pokémon anticipates and dodges the attacks of its allies.

abilities.name: Protosynthesis
abilities.effect: Raises highest stat in harsh sunlight, or if holding Booster Energy.
abilities.flavor_text: Boosts the Pokémon's most proficient stat in harsh sunlight or if the Pokémon is holding Booster Energy.

abilities.name: Static
abilities.effect: Has a 30% chance of paralyzing attacking Pokémon on contact.
abilities.flavor_text: The Pokémon is charged with static electricity and may paralyze attackers that make direct contact with it.

abilities.name: Lightning Rod
abilities.effect: Redirects single-target Electric moves to this Pokémon where possible.  Absorbs Electric moves, raising Special Attack one stage.
abilities.flavor_text: The Pokémon draws in all Electric-type moves. Instead of taking damage from them, its Sp. Atk stat is boosted.

abilities.name: Pressure
abilities.effect: Increases the PP cost of moves targetting the Pokémon by one.
abilities.flavor_text: Puts other Pokémon under pressure, causing them to expend more PP to use their moves.

abilities.name: Inner Focus
abilities.effect: Prevents flinching.
abilities.flavor_text: The Pokémon's intense focus prevents it from flinching or being affected by Intimidate.

abilities.name: Synchronize
abilities.effect: Copies burns, paralysis, and poison received onto the Pokémon that inflicted them.
abilities.flavor_text: If the Pokémon is burned, paralyzed, or poisoned by another Pokémon, that Pokémon will be inflicted with the same status condition.

abilities.name: Trace
abilities.effect: Copies an opponent's ability upon entering battle.
abilities.flavor_text: When it enters a battle, the Pokémon copies an opposing Pokémon's Ability.

abilities.name: Telepathy
abilities.effect: Protects against friendly Pokémon's damaging moves.
abilities.flavor_text: The Pokémon anticipates and dodges the attacks of its allies.

abilities.name: Mold Breaker
abilities.effect: Bypasses targets' abilities if they could hinder or prevent a move.
abilities.flavor_text: The Pokémon's moves are unimpeded by the Ability of the target.

abilities.name: Sheer Force
abilities.effect: Strengthens moves with extra effects to 1.3× their power, but prevents their extra effects.
abilities.flavor_text: Removes any additional effects from the Pokémon's moves, but increases the moves' power.

abilities.name: Run Away
abilities.effect: Ensures success fleeing from wild battles.
abilities.flavor_text: Enables a sure getaway from wild Pokémon.

abilities.name: Flash Fire
abilities.effect: Protects against Fire moves.  Once one has been blocked, the Pokémon's own Fire moves inflict 1.5× damage until it leaves battle.
abilities.flavor_text: If hit by a Fire-type move, the Pokémon absorbs the flames and uses them to power up its own Fire-type moves.

abilities.name: Flame Body
abilities.effect: Has a 30% chance of burning attacking Pokémon on contact.
abilities.flavor_text: Contact with the Pokémon may burn the attacker.
